description: Brock Martin is a lifelong West Tennessean. He was born in Carroll County and raised in Camden, Tennessee. He currently resides in Huntingdon, Tennessee with his wife, Krista, and their five year old son, Steele. Brock is the son of two public school educators and knows first hand the impact that strong teachers have on rural communities.
